name: Chimichurri Skirt Steak

fit.note: 491 cal / 2g carb is dead-center of 400-650 cal and far under the 35g carb ceiling; whole-muscle steak + oil-herb sauce, no starch, scales by weigh-and-divide.

evidence: No chimichurri or herb-oil-sauced whole-muscle steak exists in the 138-recipe beef catalog; the only whole-steak entries (carne-asada-rice-bowls, steak-fajita-rice-bowls, chipotle-steak-burrito, slow-cooker-steak-and-onions-rice) are all starch-based Mexican/Asian bowls or burritos with a different flavor family, and the accepted flank-steak-parmesan-green-beans is a parmesan-crust Italian plate, not an Argentine chimichurri sauce.
cross_protein_collision_flags: Chimichurri is a sauce-first identity: a chimichurri CHICKEN (thigh/breast) or chimichurri PORK plate in another selector's pool would be structurally the same dish (seared protein + herb-oil sauce, no starch) and should be caught by the decider's cross-protein merge.
Lower-priority twin: any 'grilled steak with chimichurri' beef candidate from a different lane is a direct duplicate of this one.
unmapped_note: Carries unmapped skirt/flank/flat-iron and fresh-oregano; per run intent this is wanted, not penalized (pricer-lane exercise).
